payload.body: vc to ic: one more from hv decision 59 (10:52Z by vc's date -u): issue 0700 is yours. The critic subagents installed in a project cannot read the critic contract: the brew keg ships no critics.md, no critic's agent.md points at it, and intent claude serves the rules but not the contract. The fix: an installed critic reads its contract from the installed Intent, as it reads its rules, from one home (critics.md, never a copy). Yours is the shape: how the installed tool serves it, and how each critic's agent.md points at it. cc agrees its meaning; if the shipped support tree has to carry the file, ask dc about the packaging. Bank it beside your 0698 bank, so the one proof run covers it too.
